title: Windsurf Pricing Guide: How It Compares to Modelence
summary: Windsurf pricing explained: compare plans, usage limits, extra costs, and Modelence to find the right option for building and shipping apps.
body_markdown:
TL;DR


## Key takeaways


-


Windsurf replaced its old credit system with daily and weekly usage quotas in March 2026.


-


Pro is the main plan for regular individual use, while Max targets much heavier agent workloads.


-


Tab completions and inline edits are unlimited and do not consume agent quota.


-


Model and task complexity affect how quickly quota is used.


-


Windsurf covers coding, while production infrastructure is separate.


Ask AI about this post:


Windsurf pricing changed materially on March 19, 2026.


The credit system was replaced with daily and weekly usage allowances, Pro increased from $15 to $20/month, Teams increased from $30 to $40/full seat/month with an $80/month minimum, and a $200 Max plan was added.


Extra usage is now billed at Application Programming Interface (API) rates instead of prepaid credit packs.


Those prices cover the coding tool, not the infrastructure needed to host and run what you build. Pricing details verified in August 2026.


This guide covers the current plans, quotas, overages, competitor pricing, and the additional cost of actually shipping an app.


## **Windsurf Pricing at a Glance**


Windsurf currently has Free, Pro, Teams, Max, and Enterprise plans, with paid tiers mainly differing by agent usage and team controls.


**Plan** **Monthly Price** **Billing Unit** **Included Usage** **Best For**


**Free** $0 Individual Light agent quota Occasional use


**Pro** $20/month Individual Higher daily/weekly quotas Daily developers


**Teams** $80/month minimum; $40/full seat Team + seat Quota per full developer Collaborative teams


**Max** $200/month Individual Significantly higher quotas Heavy agent users


**Enterprise** Custom Contract Custom Large organizations


The pricing details were verified in August 2026.


## **What Changed in March 2026 And Why Most Windsurf Pricing Guides Are Outdated**


On March 19, 2026, Windsurf replaced monthly credits with daily and weekly usage quotas.


At launch, Pro rose from $15 to $20/month, Teams from $30 to $40/seat/month, and the new Max plan launched at $200/month.


The pricing details were verified in August 2026.


Other changes included:


- Add-on credit packs were replaced by extra usage billed at API rates.
- Existing Pro and Teams subscribers kept their previous prices.
- Purchased credits were converted into equivalent dollar balances.
- Usage began varying by model, context, and task complexity.


Cognition said the change was intended to make short and complex requests consume usage more proportionally instead of charging the same credit per prompt.


## **What Each Windsurf Plan Has to Offer**


Windsurf’s plans mainly differ by agent usage, model access, and team controls. Unlimited Tab completions and inline edits are available across plans.


The pricing details below were verified in August 2026.


### **Free: $0/month**


- **What it costs:** $0 with no trial expiry.
- **What it unlocks:** Light agent usage, limited models, unlimited Tab completions, and unlimited inline edits.
- **Who shouldn’t buy it:** Daily users who need frontier models for complex coding work.


### **Pro: $20/month**


- **What it costs:** $20/month, with extra usage billed at API pricing.
- **What it unlocks:** Higher quotas, full OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini model access, plus free use of Windsurf’s SWE 1.7 and leading open-source models.
- **Who shouldn’t buy it:** Light users who can stay within Free. Cursor Pro also costs $20/month, so the better value depends on workflow and usage.


Using Windsurf’s SWE models for routine work can preserve more quota than routing everything through frontier models.


### **Teams: $80/month minimum; $40/full seat**


- **What it costs:** $40/month per full seat, subject to an $80/month team minimum. Each full developer receives an individual quota rather than a pooled allowance.
- **What it unlocks:** Centralized billing, usage analytics, collaboration, and priority support.
- **Who shouldn’t buy it:** Teams that only need individual coding access. The plan costs more than separate Pro accounts and becomes worthwhile when shared administration and team controls justify the premium.


### **Max: $200/month**


- **What it costs:** $200/month.
- **What it unlocks:** Significantly higher agent quotas for power users.
- **Who shouldn’t buy it:** Pro users spending less than roughly $180/month on additional usage. If Pro plus overages exceeds $200 and Max’s quota covers the workload, Max can be more economical.


At the same $200/month price point, Cursor offers Ultra with 20x Pro usage, while Claude Max 20x also costs $200/month.


### **Enterprise: Custom**


- **What it costs:** Custom pricing through Windsurf sales.
- **What it unlocks:** Single sign-on (SSO), enterprise administration, dedicated account management, priority support, and dedicated deployment options.
- **Who shouldn’t buy it:** Organizations without enterprise-level governance, security, or deployment requirements. Existing Enterprise customers continued under their existing agreements after the March 2026 pricing change.


## **How Windsurf's Quota System Works**


Windsurf quotas apply mainly to agentic work and model usage. Actual consumption varies by model, task complexity, context size, and reasoning required.


### **What Doesn't Count Against Your Quota**


Tab completions and inline edits are unlimited across plans and do not consume the agent usage allowance. This makes Tab useful for routine coding without using higher-cost agent capacity.


### **The Daily and Weekly Caps**


Pro and Teams full seats have both daily and weekly quotas.


The daily allowance is greater than one-seventh of the weekly allowance, so several heavy days can still exhaust the weekly quota before the next reset. Max uses a larger weekly quota with no daily cap.


### **Model Choice Changes the Cost**


Different models consume quota at different rates. Cognition's published estimates show how widely effective message capacity can vary:


**Model tier** **Pro and Teams** **Max**


Premium Plus: Opus 4.6, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.3-Codex 7–27 messages/day 42–170 messages/day


Premium: Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.2, Gemini Pro 8–101 messages/day 47–631 messages/day


Lightweight: Haiku, Flash 47–190 messages/day 291–1,190 messages/day


These are estimates, not fixed message limits.


Using lightweight or coding-optimized models for routine work can stretch the same quota much further than using frontier models for every task.


## **What Happens When You Run Out**


When you exhaust your included Windsurf quota, paid users can continue with **on-demand credits** . These are prepaid dollar-based credits that roll over, can be topped up manually, and support auto-reload.


**Usage pattern** **Best fit**


Light or occasional use Free, or Pro if Free becomes restrictive


Daily professional use Pro at $20/month + occasional on-demand usage


Heavy agent use Max at $200/month if you regularly exceed Pro


The pricing details were verified in August 2026.


To stretch your allowance, use Windsurf’s lower-cost models for routine work, reserve frontier models for harder tasks, rely on unlimited Tab where appropriate, and monitor usage during your first week before choosing a higher tier.


## **Windsurf Pricing Against the Competition**


Windsurf Pro sits in the same $20/month range as Cursor Pro and Claude Pro, while GitHub Copilot Pro costs less. Replit costs more monthly but includes broader app-building and deployment infrastructure.

**Windsurf** $0 Pro: $20/month Max: $200/month Daily/weekly quotas + paid extra usage


**Cursor** Free Pro: $20/month Ultra: $200/month Included model usage + on-demand usage


**GitHub Copilot** $0 Pro: $10/month Pro+: $39; Max: $100/month Monthly AI Credits + paid additional usage


**Claude Code** No standalone free tier Claude Pro: $20/month or $17/month billed annually Max: $100 or $200/month Shared Claude and Claude Code usage limits


**Replit** Free Core: $25/month or $20/month annually Pro: $100/month or $95/month annually Subscription with included monthly credits


The pricing details were verified in August 2026.

Windsurf and Modelence solve different problems.


Windsurf pricing primarily covers AI-assisted coding inside its integrated development environment (IDE), while Modelence combines AI app building with backend infrastructure and deployment.

**Monthly price** $0 $20 $0 $20


**What the price covers** AI coding tools AI coding + higher agent usage App building + backend App building + production capabilities

Windsurf is the more natural fit for developers who primarily want an AI-powered editor.


Modelence covers more of the path from building to running the application, including database, authentication, cron jobs, and managed deployment.

Windsurf is a strong choice for developers who want an AI-powered coding environment.


Modelence is better suited to builders who also want to run the finished app without assembling separate hosting, database, authentication, and monitoring services.

## Frequently asked questions (FAQs)


How much does Windsurf cost per month?


Windsurf costs $0 for Free, $20/month for Pro, $200/month for Max, while Teams costs $40/month per full seat with an $80/month minimum.


Is Windsurf free?


Yes, Windsurf has a free plan with light agent usage and unlimited Tab completions.


Did Windsurf raise its prices in 2026?


Yes, Pro increased from $15 to $20/month, and Teams pricing also increased in March 2026.


Are Windsurf credits gone?


The old prompt-credit system is gone; Windsurf now uses usage allowances with paid extra usage.


What happens when you hit your Windsurf quota?


Paid users can continue with on-demand usage billed against prepaid dollar credits.


Does Tab autocomplete use quota?


No, Tab completions do not consume your agent usage allowance.


Is Windsurf cheaper than Cursor?


Their standard Pro plans both cost $20/month, so value depends more on workflow and usage.


Was I grandfathered into the old Windsurf price?


Existing eligible Pro and Teams subscribers kept their previous pricing after the March 2026 change.


Does Windsurf include hosting for the apps you build?


No, Windsurf is primarily an AI coding environment and does not include production app hosting.


Does Windsurf give you a database and authentication?


No, database and authentication services must be added separately.
